tasks.short: Maintain student attendance, grades and other required records.

steps.what: Capture actual attendance, examiner-authorized grades and other required student record facts with their source
outputs: actual record input draft with source references

steps.what: Validate student IDs, course and assessment versions, result ranges and missing or conflicting attendance facts
inputs: actual record input draft with source references
outputs: checked student record facts and resolved exceptions

steps.what: Prepare matching LMS and student-information record update drafts from checked actual facts using fixed field mappings
inputs: checked student record facts and resolved exceptions
outputs: complete proposed LMS and student-information updates with destinations

steps.what: Approve the finished exact attendance, grade and required-record updates for each student in both destinations
inputs: complete proposed LMS and student-information updates with destinations

steps.what: Commit the approved exact internal LMS record updates
Commit the approved exact internal student-information record updates

tasks.design: Configure native import, validation and record mapping in {LMS} and {OTHER}, the student-information system, before custom code. The teacher captures actual attendance and already authorized grades, including manual entry and exception resolution. Exact mappings produce drafts for both destinations. Review the completed pair before separate gated commits; any changed student, value or destination voids approval. {DOCS} retains source evidence. No model, grading decision, student publication or automatic notification is included.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual student facts are copied and reconciled across course and central records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record imports and deterministic field mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting student facts and authority for corrections.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm that the record represents the actual student and authorized outcome.
tasks.altitude: Record maintenance supports existing examiner decisions.

reach.learn: Keep capture, authorization and destination-specific commits traceable.

evidence.claim: Radboud describes grades needing publication in both Brightspace and OSIRIS, demonstrating a real dual-record workflow rather than a local baseline.
Native import validation and fixed mappings can prepare matching student record updates.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured. This design assumes two record destinations with native import support; one-system courses need a different baseline.

s1 retains actual attendance capture and manual entry of student ID, course/session, date, attendance fact, authorized result, assessment version and source. A roster or login is not proof of presence.
Grading is separately counted in the grading task. s2 resolves missing or conflicting actual values; unknown attendance or grades remain unresolved rather than inferred.

Teacher authority is limited to existing authorized record maintenance. This graph stages internal records only; student-facing release or notices require separate approved actions and are not credited here.
unknowns: Native import permissions and actual duplicate-entry effort.
research_questions: What record time remains after actual capture, mapping exceptions and review?

already_counted.description: Actual capture, validation exceptions and final update review.

incremental.description: Maintain course/student field mappings and exception checks.

approvals.approved_version: exact final internal LMS student updates, values and course destination
exact final internal student-information updates, values and central record destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: ten validation, twenty mapping and ten actual second-system transfer hours saved less two upkeep. Low: current native transfers and validation leave no benefit. Same-LMS save, actual attendance capture and grading decisions retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain scheduled office hours to advise and assist students.

steps.what: Prepare actual office-hour slots, location, access instructions and the course notice
inputs: course timetable and existing access needs
outputs: complete proposed office-hour schedule and notice

steps.what: Approve the final office-hour slots, location, instructions and exact course notice audience
inputs: complete proposed office-hour schedule and notice

steps.what: Commit the approved office-hour slots to the internal teaching calendar
Publish the approved office-hour notice to the exact student course audience
Retrieve actual course, assessment or student context needed for office-hour advice
inputs: existing permitted course and student records
outputs: checked advice references and unresolved questions

steps.what: Remain available during scheduled office hours and advise and assist the actual students
inputs: checked advice references and unresolved questions
outputs: actual advice, assistance and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Prepare any required actual advising note with advice given, limits and agreed follow-up
inputs: actual advice, assistance and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Approve the final actual advising note and restricted internal record destination
Commit the approved actual advising note to the restricted internal advising record

tasks.design: Use native {CALENDAR} office-hour entries and {LMS} course notices, with {DOCS} references and advising notes. Finish the actual schedule and notice before approval, calendar commit and separate student publication. Native course links reduce reference retrieval while all scheduled availability and advice remain human. Capture actual advice afterward, then approve and separately commit the finished note. Changes void approval. No model or automated student advice is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Office-hour information and advice references are repeatedly retrieved and filed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar/course links and controlled note filing.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a student's difficulty and giving appropriate support.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt advice to the student's actual understanding and circumstances.

ambition.what: Reduce administration around existing office hours.

tasks.altitude: Student advice stays with the teacher.

reach.learn: Distinguish actual advice from scheduled availability.

evidence.claim: Native calendars, course notices and indexed references can support human office-hour provision.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. s1 includes manually capturing actual slot, location and access details; s5 includes manually finding student/course context when links fail.
The teacher remains available for the full scheduled period; no idle office-hour time is credited as saved.
s7 manually captures actual advice, agreed follow-up and limits where a note is already required. If no note is part of existing work, remove its baseline and filing benefit.
No separate student follow-up message is promised by this design; any such message requires its own draft, final approval and external send.
unknowns: Actual reference retrieval and advising-note requirements.
research_questions: Does native context access reduce preparation without reducing scheduled availability?

exact final office-hour notice and student course audience
actual completed advising note and restricted record location

tasks.short: Participate in student recruitment, registration and placement activities.

steps.what: Retrieve current engineering programme, registration and placement requirements and verify effective versions
Participate in recruitment events and student discussions about engineering study and registration
inputs: actual prospective or current student questions
outputs: actual recruitment discussions and student requests

steps.what: Capture actual student registration or placement facts, clarify missing information and match the correct student and programme
inputs: actual recruitment discussions and student requests
outputs: checked actual student case facts with gaps

steps.what: Evaluate the student's actual questions and placement needs and choose the teacher's advice or contribution to registration and placement
inputs: checked actual student case facts with gaps
outputs: teacher's reasoned registration or placement contribution

steps.what: Prepare the actual participation record and factual student next-step message from the teacher's contribution
inputs: teacher's reasoned registration or placement contribution
checked actual student case facts with gaps
outputs: complete teacher contribution record and student next-step message

steps.what: Approve the final contribution record, factual next-step wording and exact student and record destinations
inputs: complete teacher contribution record and student next-step message

steps.what: Commit the approved teacher contribution to the internal recruitment or student case record
Send the approved factual next-step message to the named student

tasks.design: Configure native programme references in {DOCS}/{LMS} and structured teacher-contribution forms in {OTHER}, the student recruitment and registration case system. Actual student conversations, information capture and placement judgement remain human. Native fields reuse checked context in the record and factual {EMAIL} next-step message. Finish both before approval and separate internal commit and external send; changes void approval. This is teacher participation, not an admissions or placement decision engine, and commits no enrollment or placement status. No model is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current programme references and actual teacher contributions are repeatedly assembled.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case forms and versioned programme information.
tasks.still_hard: Individual student needs, fit and fair placement judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Explain engineering study realistically and understand the student's situation.
tasks.altitude: Recruitment discussion and educational judgement remain human.

reach.learn: Keep a teacher's advice distinct from an authorized enrollment or placement decision.

evidence.claim: Student case systems and native document templates can reuse programme and student identifiers in reviewed contributions.

assumptions: Shares are provisional across recruitment, registration and placement participation. s1 includes manual version checks; s3 includes actual student ID, request, programme, evidence and missing-information clarification.
No complete application or self-service record is newly demanded without capture time. The teacher's own actual contribution and chosen next steps are manually entered in s5.

Registration and placement staff retain their existing decision work; no saving is credited and no new assessment burden is transferred. Enrollment or final placement commits and offers are separate authorized work.
Student messages contain factual next steps and the teacher's approved contribution, never an inferred admission or placement offer.
unknowns: Native contribution forms and actual teacher role in registration.
research_questions: How much preparation is repeated once actual student capture and judgement are counted?

already_counted.description: Actual student capture and final contribution preparation/review.

incremental.description: Maintain programme references and contribution fields.

exact final factual next-step message and named external student recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: six reference, two form preparation and two actual next-steps send hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native guidance and routing remove the benefit. Same-case-record commitment, conversation, actual capture and judgement retain full effort.

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks, laboratory equipment and other materials and supplies.

steps.what: Establish actual engineering course material and laboratory equipment needs, quantities and constraints
inputs: actual available books, supplies and equipment
outputs: checked material requirements and actual stock gaps

steps.what: Retrieve textbook editions, equipment specifications, supplier quotations, prices and availability
inputs: checked material requirements and actual stock gaps
outputs: checked material and supply comparison with unknowns

steps.what: Select suitable textbooks and laboratory supplies or equipment against teaching, compatibility and budget requirements
inputs: checked material and supply comparison with unknowns
checked material requirements and actual stock gaps

steps.what: Prepare the exact material purchase order and supplier message using checked item, quantity, price and delivery fields
inputs: actual supplier quotations and delivery details
outputs: complete proposed purchase order and supplier message

steps.what: Approve the final purchase order, price, quantities, delivery address and exact supplier message destination
inputs: complete proposed purchase order and supplier message

steps.what: Commit the approved purchase order to the internal procurement system
Send the approved material purchase order and message to the named external supplier
Obtain and physically check actual delivered textbooks or equipment for quantity, edition, condition and suitability
inputs: actual delivered materials and delivery note

steps.what: Prepare the actual receipt record from delivered quantities, editions, equipment IDs and discrepancies
Approve the finished actual material receipt and exact internal order destination
Commit the approved actual receipt to internal procurement records

tasks.design: Configure native catalogues, item fields and purchase/receipt templates in {PROCUREMENT} before custom code. {DOCS} holds teaching and compatibility requirements. Actual need checks, selection and physical receipt checks remain human. Finish the order and {EMAIL} supplier message before approval, distinct internal order commit and external supplier send. Actual delivered quantities and condition are captured later, then their finished receipt receives a separate approval and commit. Changes void approval. No model, inferred receipt or automatic invoice payment is included.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material specifications and purchasing details are repeatedly found and copied.
tasks.enabler_now: Native procurement catalogues and controlled order/receipt fields.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching suitability, equipment compatibility and actual delivered condition.
tasks.human_edge: Select materials that fit the engineering course and laboratory.

ambition.what: Reduce purchase administration around human material selection.

tasks.altitude: Educational selection and physical checks stay human.

reach.learn: Keep ordered and actually received equipment quantities separate.

evidence.claim: Native procurement catalogues and order/receipt templates can reuse verified item and supplier fields.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for purchases within the teacher's existing delegated budget and order authority. Additional required procurement authorization must be separately counted where applicable.
s1 includes actual stock checking and need capture; s2 manually reads and checks edition, item specification, quoted price, availability and source date when catalogues are incomplete.

s4 manually enters chosen item, quantity, quote, price, delivery and supplier destination where reuse is unavailable. s9 manually enters actual received quantities, edition or serial ID, condition and discrepancies.
Supplier fulfillment and invoice processing are existing downstream work with no saving claimed; receipt is not inferred from order status.
unknowns: Catalogue coverage and actual teacher purchasing authority.
research_questions: What purchasing preparation remains after checking specifications and actual receipts?
